purpose: Separate authored training population; original semantic-calibration-v1 queries/labels are evaluation only. No evaluation receipt may enter fitHybridRelevance.

features: per-query cosine population z-score; zero when variance is zero
preregisteredAlgorithm.loss: mean binary cross entropy plus L2 on non-intercept weights

labelReview: Each query requires precisely the listed function's operation; the other nineteen authored operations do not implement it. One positive per query in this controlled training population; production may return multiple. Fixed manual summaries are query-independent and describe source behavior. No original evaluation sources or summaries are reused.

samples.query: Change every letter in supplied text to its uppercase form.
samples.summary: Returns the upper case form of the string without modifying other characters.
samples.source: export function t01(s: string) { return s.toUpperCase(); }

samples.query: Discard whitespace from the beginning and end of text.
samples.summary: Returns the string after removing leading and trailing whitespace.
samples.source: export function t02(s: string) { return s.trim(); }

samples.query: Keep only the strictly positive members of a numeric array.
samples.summary: Returns a new array containing just values greater than zero.
samples.source: export function t03(xs: number[]) { return xs.filter(x => x > 0); }

samples.query: Transform each number in a collection to its square.
samples.summary: Returns a fresh array with every present input element multiplied by itself.
samples.source: export function t04(xs: number[]) { return xs.map(x => x * x); }

samples.query: Round the supplied value upward to the nearest integer.
samples.summary: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the input number.
samples.source: export function t05(n: number) { return Math.ceil(n); }

samples.query: Find the nonnegative magnitude of a signed number.
samples.summary: Returns the absolute value of the input number.
samples.source: export function t06(n: number) { return Math.abs(n); }

samples.query: Serialize a JavaScript value as JSON text.
samples.summary: Returns JSON serialization of the value, with native JSON.stringify errors and unsupported-value behavior.
samples.source: export function t07(x: unknown) { return JSON.stringify(x); }

samples.query: Separate a string into lines at newline characters.
samples.summary: Returns an array of substrings split at each newline, preserving empty fields.
samples.source: export function t08(s: string) { return s.split(String.fromCharCode(10)); }

samples.query: Join string array members with a comma between adjacent entries.
samples.summary: Returns the array entries joined with commas, or an empty string for an empty array.
samples.source: export function t09(xs: string[]) { return xs.join(','); }

samples.query: Test whether the number is finite rather than NaN or an infinity.
samples.summary: Returns true exactly for finite numeric values without type coercion.
samples.source: export function t10(n: number) { return Number.isFinite(n); }

samples.query: Check whether a string begins with the requested prefix.
samples.summary: Returns whether the input string starts with the prefix, case sensitively.
samples.source: export function t11(s: string, prefix: string) { return s.startsWith(prefix); }

samples.query: Return the position of the first matching member in a list.
samples.summary: Returns the array index of the first strictly equal member, or negative one when absent.
samples.source: export function t12<T>(xs: T[], value: T) { return xs.indexOf(value); }

samples.query: Choose the supplied default only when the value is null or undefined.
samples.summary: Returns the fallback for nullish input and otherwise returns the original value.
samples.source: export function t13<T>(x: T | null | undefined, fallback: T) { return x ?? fallback; }

samples.query: List an object's own enumerable string property names.
samples.summary: Returns the own enumerable string keys of the object in Object.keys order.
samples.source: export function t14(x: object) { return Object.keys(x); }

samples.query: Exchange the positions of the two members of a pair.
samples.summary: Returns a new two element array containing the second input followed by the first.
samples.source: export function t15<A,B>(a: A, b: B) { return [b, a] as const; }

samples.query: Increase the input numeric value by exactly one.
samples.summary: Returns the number plus one using ordinary JavaScript arithmetic.
samples.source: export function t16(n: number) { return n + 1; }

samples.query: Repeat a text value the requested number of times.
samples.summary: Returns the string repeated n times with native String.repeat range errors.
samples.source: export function t17(s: string, n: number) { return s.repeat(n); }

samples.query: Turn a Map into its array of key and value pairs.
samples.summary: Returns a fresh array of Map entries in insertion order.
samples.source: export function t18<K,V>(map: Map<K,V>) { return Array.from(map.entries()); }

samples.query: Determine whether every numeric array element is greater than zero.
samples.summary: Returns true if all present array elements are positive, including true for an empty array.
samples.source: export function t19(xs: number[]) { return xs.every(x => x > 0); }

samples.query: Multiply each number in an array by a caller supplied scale factor.
samples.summary: Returns a new array with every present element multiplied by the provided factor.
samples.source: export function t20(xs: number[], factor: number) { return xs.map(x => x * factor); }
